purpose: Teach: フロイト/語りかけ/サーカス/サイレン/培っ/エディタ/必殺/イースター

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、心理学の授業で、本気で、絶対、フロイト、絶対、出てきたよ、お前、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: Riku, Freud actually came up in psych class, right? Do you remember that?
lines.style: Bright, quick delivery. Leans forward slightly on the question. Genuinely curious—testing whether he was paying attention. Natural teenage rhythm, no affectation.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。お祖母ちゃん、本気で、絶対、語りかけるように、絶対、お話、絶対、してくれるよ、桜、本気で、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yeah. Your grandma really talks about it with me the way she tells stories. I'm genuinely grateful for that, Sakura.
lines.style: Soft, genuine warmth underlying the words. Slightly vulnerable admission. Pace unhurried—he's choosing his words carefully because it matters. Quiet respect in his tone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 夏休み、本気で、絶対、サーカス、絶対、お父さんが、絶対、連れていってくれるって、リク、本気で、絶対、嬉しい
lines.en: Summer break—Dad's actually taking us to the circus. I'm really excited about it, Riku.
lines.style: Energy lifts noticeably. Genuine enthusiasm breaking through her usual cool. Quick, eager tempo on the announcement. A moment of unguarded happiness.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 夜、本気で、絶対、パトカーのサイレン、絶対、聞こえたぜ、桜、お互いに、絶対、気をつけような
lines.en: Last night I heard the police siren. We should both be careful out there, okay?
lines.style: Shifts to serious. Slight protective edge underneath. Speaking quietly but with intention. Not alarmist—just real. Direct eye contact level.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、培ってきた、絶対、信頼関係、絶対、すごいって、絶対、思うよ、リク
lines.en: The trust your dad built with you over time is really incredible. I think that's amazing.
lines.style: Sincere admiration. Speaking slower here, like she's noticed something real and wants him to hear it. No sarcasm, no deflection. Genuine respect in her voice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: プログラミングの、本気で、絶対、エディタ、絶対、最新のを、絶対、買ったぜ、桜、お前、見たい?本気で
lines.en: I just got the latest code editor. Do you want to check it out?
lines.style: Casual enthusiasm, slightly self-aware. Quick tempo. Offering but not pushing—leaves space for him to decline. Genuinely proud of the purchase in a low-key way.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 試合で、本気で、絶対、必殺技、絶対、決めたいよね、リク、お互いに、絶対、頑張ろう
lines.en: In the match, I want to nail that finishing move. Let's both push hard and do this, yeah?
lines.style: Determined but encouraging. Energy is focused, not scattered. Speaks as a teammate, not a competitor. Steady conviction beneath the words. Slight lift at the end—inviting him in.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: イースター、本気で、絶対、家族で、絶対、お祝いするって、絶対、決めてるんだ、桜、お前、興味、ある?絶対
lines.en: We're doing Easter as a family thing. Are you interested in coming?
lines.style: Relaxed invitation, slight vulnerability underneath. Testing the waters gently. Hopeful but casual—not desperate. Warm tone that suggests she cares about his answer.
